scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix otp-server
scripts.build: npm run install-all && npm run build-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "backend,frontend,otp" -c "yellow,blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm start --prefix otp-server"
